function.name: test_build
function.description: Run fresh copies of the current blueprint in Minecraft, one experiment per entry of tests. Each test imports its own copy, operates native buttons/levers and observes real block states at game ticks; tests do not affect one another, the blueprint or the user's live world in the browser. Each test has the full budgets on its own (they are not shared across the call); a test too dense to finish within its wall-clock budget is stopped with an error that says how many ticks it reached. Tests run side by side when the machine has room; results come back per test in the order given. A test that fails does not stop the others. ok means the experiment completed, not that the design passed. Full observations of each test are saved under /work/verification; small results are also returned inline. Every result includes a bounded preview of initial states, sampled changes, and input failures.

probes.description: Positions to read in blueprint coordinates, in the same order in every observation. Probes and sample times share a total work budget.

at.description: Block coordinates for interactions; fractional coordinates allowed only for drop.

velocity.description: Required only for drop: native incoming item velocity in blocks per game tick.

present.description: Required only for book: false removes the lectern book through its native menu; true restores that same previously removed book, or places an explicit supplied book into an empty lectern. Explicit supply requires item, count:1 and stack; it cannot overwrite a present or previously removed book.

page.description: Required only for page: zero-based page in the existing lectern book. Out-of-range requests fail without changing it.

slot.description: Required for insert/extract: zero-based slot in this block, not both halves of a double chest.

count.description: Required for insert/extract/drop and explicit book supply (exactly1 for books). The entire amount must fit or be present; otherwise nothing changes.

stack.description: Optional for insert/drop or explicit book supply: complete native item SNBT and its data version, for potions, enchanted books or named items. Minecraft upgrades and decodes it; ID/count must match the action. Invalid data fails before insertion.

item.description: Required for insert/drop or explicit book supply: Minecraft item ID, e.g. minecraft:iron_ingot.

yaw.description: Only for use: the direction the player faces in degrees (0 south, 90 west, 180 north, 270 east). Required to use a fence gate, which opens away from the player; no other block reads it.

actions.description: Inputs after settling: press a button or toggle a lever. Native button release is automatic. use is a survival player's right click with an empty hand, through Minecraft's own interaction, on a door or trapdoor (opens or closes it; iron ones cannot be opened by hand), fence gate (needs yaw), repeater (next delay), comparator (switches mode), note block (next note, played), daylight detector (inverts it), redstone dust (a dot becomes a cross and a cross a dot) or decorated pot (wobbles); a use that changes nothing fails. drain {tick,type,at} empties one container block (one chest half) through its native removeItem, slot by slot; its outcome lists every removed stack under removed, in the inventory observation format. drop supplies a native dropped-item stack at the specified position and velocity; the outcome records its UUID. It represents an external item input, not a circuit output. book removes or restores the same lectern book, or places an explicitly supplied written/writable book into an empty lectern; page selects an existing lectern book page through the native Minecraft menu interaction. Defaults to no inputs.

block_data_version.description: Optional data version of all source blueprint block states. Minecraft upgrades their IDs/properties using its native block-state data fixer before placement and reports the migrations. Omit for current-version builds. Does not rewrite the blueprint.

block_entities.description: Optional initial block-entity data, loaded while frozen before settling. Not saved to the blueprint. Include the same data on every test. Minecraft upgrades older data using its native data fixer.

scheduled_ticks.description: Optional authoritative saved schematic tick queue, restored while frozen under strict placement. Replaces placement-generated block/fluid ticks inside bounds; empty entries means an empty saved queue. Preserve source delays, priorities and signed 64-bit sub-tick order. Does not persist in the blueprint.

sub_tick.description: Original signed 64-bit order as decimal text.

entities.description: Optional boat/raft, dropped-item, item-frame, painting, armor-stand or ordinary/container/furnace/TNT minecart entity NBT, imported natively while frozen. at uses fractional blueprint coordinates and must match NBT Pos. Preserve source UUID. An ordinary minecart may retain one original dolphin passenger, including its UUID, position and equipment. Other passenger trees and all leashes fail explicitly. Include again in every test; report records importedEntities.

inventory_missing.description: Default error. Use report for containers that move or break: inventory is explicitly null when no container exists, alongside the actual block state. Null is not an empty inventory.

world_inventories.description: Read every loaded block-container inventory, container-entity inventory (including hopper/chest minecarts), and item-frame contents at each sample. Boats and minecarts also report vehicle_item using their native pick-item identity, separately from their cargo. Dolphin equipment is included so held input items remain observable. Reports kind, type, position, entity UUID where applicable, and full item stacks. Combine this census with item_entities for conservation; do not count the same block again from inventory_probes. Unopened loot tables fail explicitly instead of generating loot while observing.

living_entities.description: Read all loaded non-player living entities at each sample: native entity type, UUID, blueprint-relative position, health, max_health and dead flag. Read-only; use for mob routing and safety. An absent entity is not proof of delivery or survival. Keep the complete route loaded with build/probe bounds.

item_entities.description: Include all loaded dropped-item entities in the isolated world at each sample, with identity, position and full item SNBT. Read-only; useful for tracking items in transit.

inventory_probes.description: Subset of probes that are containers. Adds nonempty slots with item IDs, counts and complete item SNBT to every observation. A missing container is an experiment error unless inventory_missing is report.

samples.description: Sample ticks after settling; default [0,20,100]. Samples follow inputs at the same tick. 20 ticks = 1 second.

settle_ticks.description: Ticks to run before the initial observation and input timeline; default 40. Shares the simulation-time budget with the timeline.

tests.description: One to ⟦tests⟧ experiments. Each entry holds everything one experiment needs; nothing is inherited from other entries, so repeat block_entities, entities and block_data_version in every test that needs them.
